description: This file defines structures, types, and functions for managing glyphs in the FreeType library, including glyph creation, copying, transformation, bounding box calculation, and conversion to bitmap. It provides an interface for handling various glyph formats such as bitmap and outline glyphs.

classes.name: FT_Glyph
classes.description: Handle to a generic glyph object that can contain bitmap or outline data.

classes.name: FT_BitmapGlyph
classes.description: Sub-class of FT_Glyph for bitmap glyph images.

classes.name: FT_OutlineGlyph
classes.description: Sub-class of FT_Glyph for outline (vector) glyph images.

methods.name: FT_Get_Glyph
methods.description: Extracts a glyph image from a glyph slot.

methods.name: FT_Glyph_Copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of a glyph object.

methods.name: FT_Glyph_Transform
methods.description: Applies a transformation matrix to a glyph.

methods.name: FT_Glyph_Get_CBox
methods.description: Returns the control box of a glyph, enclosing all points including Bézier control points.

methods.name: FT_Glyph_To_Bitmap
methods.description: Converts a glyph object to a bitmap glyph object.

methods.name: FT_Matrix_Multiply
methods.description: Performs matrix multiplication b = a * b.
